name: l0_data_object_registry
about: The entity data-object registry (`walks/L0-r019.md`): `CBaseEntity::HasDataObjectType` 0x1003cb00, `AddDataObjectType` 0x1003cbc0, `RemoveDataObjectType` 0x1003cc80, `GetDataObject` 0x1003cd50, `CreateDataObject` 0x1003cf50 and `DestroyDataObject` 0x1003d130 over the one type any map reaches, type 1 (the touch-link head), through a touch -- the only world entry that reaches them. `CDataObjectAccessSystem::Init` 0x1003c660 registers the touch-link accessor (vtable 0x10449390) in slot 1 at DLL init. The player teleports into `trig_in_this_room` (a `trigger_multiple` of sp_tutorial_1, enabled, clients, standing on the floor an unnamed `trigger_stealth_mod` slab also covers): `PhysicsMarkEntitiesAsTouching` 0x1003e2e0 -> `PhysicsMarkEntityAsTouched` 0x1003dc70 on the brush first: `GetDataObject(1)` finds no bit (`arm=nobit`, the mask born 0), `CreateDataObject(1)` writes bit 1 BEFORE validating (`mask_after=0x2`), passes the signed 0..31 range and the registered slot, and dispatches the accessor's create (slot 2), which hands back the zero-filled 0x14-byte head; the player gets its own head the same way, and its `Get` for the slab then takes `arm=dispatch` behind `HasDataObjectType` = 1. The map's own `OnTrigger -> trig_in_this_room.Disable` ends that pair 0.2 s later (`PhysicsCheckForEntityUntouch` 0x1003d490 -> `PhysicsNotifyOtherOfUntouch` 0x1003d640 -> `PhysicsRemoveToucher` 0x1003d770): the brush's `Get` dispatches, its node goes, its list is empty, so `DestroyDataObject(1)` dispatches the accessor's destroy (slot 3) with the bit still set and only then `RemoveDataObjectType` clears it (`mask_before=0x2 mask_after=0x0`); the player keeps its slab node, so its object is NOT destroyed (`H[+8] != H`). A second teleport into `trig_in_that_room` (the same authored self-Disable) creates that brush's head and, when its Disable ends the pair, destroys it; the player's list is then empty and its own object is destroyed after the loop. No arm takes `range` or `nullslot`: every caller passes 1 and slot 1 is registered. At the end both brushes and the player read `m_fDataObjectTypes` = 0. Reported as `fail`, a site is missing, out of order, or names other arms or masks than retail's, or the player's object is destroyed while a node remains.
